text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Triple Tiara behind us,<n>Mejiro Dober and I
have to decide on<n>our next race...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to create a new Mejiro<n>legacy, then
there's one race that<n>would be the perfect send-off
to her<n>classic year!

Well, Trainer? What do you think I<n>should run in
next?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This race will be an invaluable<n>experience for her.
She'll be able to<n>see firsthand what races in her
fast-approaching senior year will be<n>like.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, compared to the races<n>she's run so far,
it won't be easy.<n>Not only is it a longer race, but the
competition will be on a different level.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to take this huge challenge<n>head-on with
all of our strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she'll also be racing in theArima Kinen too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I mean.

She's right. It's guaranteed that Air<n>Groove, the
Empress, will run in the<n>Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And no doubt she'll be Mejiro<n>Dober's greatest
threat and rival on<n>the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Would you rather not run the race?
Would you rather not run the race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No... You've got it backwards.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no. Sorry, I didn't get all quiet<n>because I don't
want to run in it. It's<n>the opposite, actually.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so happy. I'm finally going<n>to race against
Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to start preparing for the<n>Arima Kinen
right away. I'll need to<n>improve my stamina as well
as a few<n>other areas I'm worried about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's start training today! I'm already<n>excited
thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober doesn't look<n>discouraged in the
slightest! In fact, it<n>looks like my suggestion lit a fire
under her!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll do great. And to<n>prepare her for
success, we get right<n>to training for the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day at the Mejiro estate...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Dober, Dober! Big news!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's wrong, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's the Arima Kinen! Have you<n>looked at the
pre-race popularity poll<n>results?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, the results came out today.<n>But no, I
haven't looked at them yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-wait a second... Is this real?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You came in third out of all the other<n>prominent
racers in the lineup! That's<n>astounding, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This level of popularity is really<n>something,
especially since you're<n>still in your classic year!
Congrats,<n>Dober!

Race with your head held high, Dober.<n>We are all
looking forward to your<n>grand performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Go out there and stir up the crowd<n>into a real
frenzy, all right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Be sure to show Nakayama who you<n>are in this
moment. If you can<n>manage that, your tale will be
passed<n>down through the generations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to run in the Arima Kinen<n>with you,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I suppose there's always next year.<n>I'm sure that
race will be a story for<n>the ages!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So for now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Do your best and run a race you<n>won't regret,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove got first in the popularity<n>poll... No
surprise there!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(As part of my Mejiro legacy, I'm<n>going to show
everyone a<n>performance to remember at the<n>Arima
Kinen!)
